Boundaries.Name: resumable-clusterscan-attempts
Boundaries.Contract: Pinned sends, ASK/MOVED recovery and unsupported-command fallbacks share the enclosing page's failure-only lease. Handled failures increment retries once; successful attempts retain the empty lease.

Boundaries.Name: resumable-clusterscan-conversion
Boundaries.Contract: The enclosing page owns strict cursor decoding, key parsing, pass certification, cancellation, checkpoint construction and response disposal before final caller inspection.
